basic_info.description: Welcome to Unit 734 at The Beacon—a bright and airy junior 1-bedroom offering modern updates and unbeatable convenience. This stylish home is filled with natural light and features oversized windows and new stainless steel appliances in a well-appointed kitchen. The open layout provides a flexible living space, while the sleeping alcove offers privacy and comfort. Enjoy in-unit laundry and all the perks of The Beacon’s resort-style amenities, including a 24-hour doorman, outdoor pool, hot tubs, fitness center with sauna, clubhouse, business center, and more. Located across from Oracle Park and connected to Safeway, with easy access to dining, transit, Chase Center, Embarcadero, and the Financial District. Ideal for city living or a perfect pied-à-terre!
